messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: hosted-api-prod p99 latency > 8s and queue growth in us-west-gpu-pool. 429s and 504s observed. Alert ID: RED-INC-1769994321
Sasha (oncall): Acked. I'm pulling dashboards — give me 1 min.
Sasha (oncall): p95 now 1.8s -> 3.6s over 10m, p99 2.9s -> 9.4s. Queue length (hosted-api-request-queue) jumped from 200 -> 18k in 12m. GPU pool us-west-gpu-1 at 100% utilization.
Leah (eng-sre): seeing many 429 rate_limit? No, 429s are from our throttle layer because queue depth > 10k. Throttles started 17:31:12 UTC.
Jay (infra): autoscaler logs show repeated backoff: "scaleAttempt failed: insufficient quota: RequestOverflow". Looks like cloud quota failing to provision more GPUs in this region.
Sasha (oncall): Can we fallback to smaller model variants to relieve GPU? Can we route non-critical routes to cpu-fallback?
Mike (capacity): We're hitting provider max GPUs for this account in us-west. I can open an emergency quota request but it'll take ~30-60m. Immediate mitigation: evict lower-priority Dedicated jobs (dev/test) and enable burst_pool_from_reserved.
Leah (eng-sre): I'm running the eviction script now: `./tools/evict-dev-load --region us-west --target freed_gpus=8` — will post output.
deploy-bot: Triggered run: evict-dev-load by @Leah
Leah (eng-sre): Output:
```
2026-03-14T17:42:08Z evict: node gpu-node-42 drained, 4 gpus freed
2026-03-14T17:42:56Z evict: node gpu-node-43 drained, 4 gpus freed
Total GPUs freed: 8
```
Leah (eng-sre): After evictions, autoscaler started a new scale attempt but failed with cloud API error `QuotaExceeded: You have reached your maximum GPUs`.
Jay (infra): Ok quota path is dead. Alternate plan: enable model-variant-fallback rule to route non-SLO traffic to `mistral-small-quant` (CPU/GPU-mix) and reduce token limit to 512.
Sasha (oncall): Leah — can you toggle fallback in the routing policy? Command:
```
apictl routing update hosted-api --route /generate --fallback-model mistral-small-quant --max-tokens 512
```
Leah (eng-sre): Doing it now.
Leah (eng-sre): Done. Initial = 40% of requests now hitting fallback tier. p99 dropped from 9.4s -> 4.1s in 6m. Queue length trending down from 18k -> 2.3k.
Evelyn (cs): Several enterprise customers reported 504s. I notified AtlasMaps + LogiCore via email and opened priority support tickets. They asked for timeline; said they're seeing failed batch exports.
Sasha (oncall): Good. Please send ETA once we know if quota will clear. Mike — can you try contacting cloud support for priority uplift?
Mike (capacity): On it. Support case opened: CASE-5654. Adding severity: production outage. Also queuing an internal approval to bump commit for reserved GPUs.
Jay (infra): We also observed the autoscaler controller pod restarted 3x during the spike. Logs show OOM in the controller when trying to compute placement for 1000+ pending requests. Patch idea: throttle scale decisions when queue length > 5k to avoid controller OOM.
Sasha (oncall): Noted. I'll file a follow-up. For now: keep routing fallback enabled, evictions complete, CS notified, cloud support escalated. Operational runbook steps done: manual evict, routing fallback, CS comms.
Leah (eng-sre): I'm switching to oncall-handoff to @Jay in 20m — need to rest. I'll summarize in the incident doc.
Sasha (oncall): Thanks. Quick status: p95=1.9s, p99=3.8s, queue=~2.2k, GPU pool utilization=95%. We'll keep monitoring. If we don't see queue < 500 in 30m, consider enabling cross-region routing to us-east.
Jay (infra): I'll prepare cross-region routing plan and test canary tomorrow. For immediate: I'm staying on to monitor.
Sasha (oncall): Creating incident ticket in Jira: RED-1769994321. Adding tags: gpu-exhaustion, autoscaler-quota, hosted-api-backlog, customer-impact.
incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-1769994321. Oncall: Sasha. Severity: Sev-2.
Sasha (oncall): Handing off to @Jay now. Jay are you taking?
Jay (infra): Taking. I'll update the channel if anything changes. Please mention me for CS followups.
Evelyn (cs): Thanks all. I'll keep customers posted with rolling updates every 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Mike (capacity): Cloud support replied: 'quota increase approved to 32 GPUs, ETA 22m'. Posting case id: CLOUD-8902.
Leah (eng-sre): Good. If that lands we'll scale up, then we can disable fallback gradually. Don't revert too fast.
Sasha (oncall): Agreed. End of thread for now. Final note: immediate mitigations executed: dev evictions (8 GPUs), routing fallback to smaller model, CS notified, cloud support escalated. Postmortem assigned to Leah+Jay+Mike. :thumbsup:
